title: Matrix Hilbert 90 in positive dimension
statement: Let K be a field, n a nonzero natural number, and b a locally constant general-linear cocycle of Gal(SeparableClosure K/K) with values in GL_n(SeparableClosure K). Then there exists t in GL_n(SeparableClosure K) such that b(g) g(t) = t for every g.

source.place: Tag 03R7, injectivity argument, invariant-basis descent for n > 0

proof.text: Factor the locally constant cocycle through a finite Galois quotient, form the finite Galois averaging operator on the n-dimensional vector space, prove its invariant vectors span using linear independence of distinct field automorphisms, and extract an invariant basis as the columns of t.

theorem exists_galois_matrix_invariant_basis_normalized (K : Type u) [Field K] (n : ℕ)
    (b : Gal(SeparableClosure K/K) →
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) (SeparableClosure K))
    (hb : IsLocallyConstant b)
    (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (hcoc : ∀ g h, b g * Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map g.toRingHom (b h) = b (g * h)) :
    ∃ t : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) (SeparableClosure K),
      ∀ g, b g * Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map g.toRingHom t = t
